LESSON: ACCOUNTS OF CREATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 2.1: Accounts of Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Accounts of Creation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is the first account of creation different from the second account?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
2. identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts
3. value God’s creation by conserving the environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: value God’s creation by conserving the environment

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
• Model 2: identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts
• Model 3: value God’s creation by conserving the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
2. Practise: identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts
3. Practise: value God’s creation by conserving the environment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Accounts of Creation.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the first account of creation different from the second account?
2. Why is it important to learn about the creation accounts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
• identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts
• value God’s creation by conserving the environment
